appDesc.message: LAPLACE Login Sync is an extension to sync your login sessions
appDesc.description: Based on CookieCloud with end-to-end encryption technology to keep your login data safe and secure.

resetDesc.message: Click the above button to choose a new sync token you prefer. Click Save and Sync to take effect.

resetConfirmDesc.message: This generates a brand-new token. Data on the server tied to your current token will no longer be accessible.

restorePreviousDesc.message: Restore the sync token from before your last reset. Remember to click Save and Sync afterwards.

notInitialized.message: Extension not initialized, please click Save and Sync
